# Exhiby

> Exhiby is a live studio platform where artists open their creative studios in real time and collectors join curated, ticketed sessions to watch, learn, and support the work as it happens.

Exhiby connects independent artists ("Studios") with audiences ("Collectors"). Creators host live sessions — painting, music, design, writing, performance — that viewers can attend live, tip, chat in, and follow. Sessions can be free or paid, scheduled in advance or started ad-hoc.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page introducing live studio access and featured artists.
- [Explore Studios](/explore): Browse currently live and upcoming creative studio sessions.
- [Browse](/browse): Discover artists and sessions by category.
- [Schedule](/schedule): Upcoming scheduled live sessions across the platform.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro, and Plus plans for creators.
- [Sign in](/auth): Email and Google authentication for artists and collectors.

## Optional

- [Tickets](/tickets-history): A signed-in collector's purchased session tickets.
- [Earnings](/earnings-history): A signed-in creator's session earnings history.
- [Settings](/settings): Account and notification preferences.
